text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day—I can reach it. Beyond 
the realm of speed...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I need nothing. I won't look back. I'll 
just look ahead and run.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san... Such incredible focus... 
Aiming for this day the whole time...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um, Suzuka-san! Good lu...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And there she appears! The Silence Runner 
from another dimension, Silence Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This... razor-sharp spirit! She has truly 
tuned herself to the absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I will go. I will definitely make it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"All alone in a world no one has ever 
seen. Yes, no one can ever—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "...Who is it? This feeling..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... And you are...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Good day~, Lady Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The promised day has finally arrived. I am 
so delighted to spend it together with 
you~

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Bright... It's really Bright...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It's not like spring... not at all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have polished it until it shines 
brightly too. "Our" way of running, that 
is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day we can finally show each 
other the ideals we have envisioned.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, Bright... But...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I won't let them keep up... No one should 
be able to... No one...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Lady Suzuka is in magnificent form today. 
However, that is precisely why...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(The new ideal of our Mejiro family is 
about to be tested...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Please watch over me, Trainer. And—please 
guide me, my elder sisters.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(To flood this stage with— the radiant 
light of the Mejiros!)
